environment: Unity 6000.5.10f1 Editor Play Mode; temporary offline profile; server and client running; fixed diagnostic camera copied from the game camera; CPU Profiler disabled for final comparison

causes.name: Punctual-light shadow submission
causes.evidence: Initial CPU profile: RenderPlayModeViewCameras about 31.8 ms, AdditionalLightsShadow about 13.7 ms; disabling local shadows reduced render submission from about 29.7 ms to about 8.1 ms.

causes.name: Distant secondary bone simulation
causes.evidence: Initial CPU profile: SecondaryBoneSpring.LateUpdate about 6.4 ms across three active instances.

validation.sceneSerializedScope: 43 added documents (40 prefab light references, new GameObject/Transform/component), existing SceneRoots updated; no removed documents or other existing document changes

limitations: This is a fixed-view Editor measurement, not a standalone build or complete-map frame-rate guarantee.
Distant punctual direct lighting is culled; authored light sources, baked lighting, geometry and circuit state remain. Night-time transitions still need visual acceptance.
GPU resident drawing with GPU occlusion was tested and reverted: it increased the warmed-up median frame time to about 92.7 ms on this machine.
All-map traversal, multiple network peers and target-platform builds were not run.
